errors.what: launched a second Seattle 2022 process to parallelise, then found the first had just reached 2022; killed the duplicate after ~1 min

doc_friction.issue: pkill hook: a bracketed pattern still fails if the unbracketed text appears elsewhere in the same command (e.g. a following rm of a file with that name); split the call
num_threads was hard-coded to 4, so two held-out cities could not share the 4-core box without oversubscription; added CPIN_THREADS

deviations.why: Austin held out was added after launch on an idle core, reported but not tested
deviations.did: ran Austin at 1 thread, flagged as post-design in the LOG
deviations.result: Austin showed the selector failure at its largest (regret 60 to 68 days) and made 3 years the robust fixed choice over 6 cells

notes: Pre-registered S1-S5: S1 (best threshold differs by city), S2 (8y > 5y by >1 day), S5 (nc5 reproduces session 91 exactly) held; S3 (Y-3 censored selector regret <=1 day) and S4 (selector mean <=0) refuted: the censored Y-3 score falls monotonically with threshold in all 6 cells, so it picks 8 years everywhere (regret 11.3 d SF/Seattle, 60-68 d Austin). Post hoc: 3 years is the robust fixed choice (mean -0.80, worst +1.50 over 6 cells).
